rubric.role_summary: Senior individual-contributor product designer leading hands-on design of agentic AI experiences for retail merchants, contributing across the Retail product portfolio and supporting mobile point-of-sale strategy.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior individual-contributor product designer leading hands-on design of agentic AI experiences for retail merchants, contributing across the Retail product portfolio and supporting mobile point-of-sale strategy.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 12+ years of product design experience.
- Hands-on work across UX, interaction, and visual design.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Toronto location preferred.
- Experience leading large, ambiguous initiatives across multiple teams and delivering measurable outcomes without formal authority.
- Active use of LLMs and AI prototyping tools in a design workflow.
- Technical understanding sufficient to build prototypes that communicate ideas and to reason about engineering constraints.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Toronto, Ontario area; Other locations in Ontario; Quebec; Eastern Canada. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
